# ShackPack

> ShackPack is the surprise-product manufacturing and coin-wholesale arm of
> The Shack, based in Boca Raton, Florida. It builds graded coin, bullion,
> sports card and Pokemon card repacks for wholesale buyers and collectors.
> Every series is backed by a published checklist of what was produced for
> that series; contents vary by series, and no individual pack's contents are
> specified or guaranteed in advance.

## Products

- [Packs](https://shackpck.com/repacks): The repack catalogue, organised by
  product line (Coins and Bullion, Sports Cards, Pokemon Cards) and then by
  brand.
- [Custom builds](https://shackpck.com/build): The ShackPack Builder, for
  designing a bespoke case — artwork, configuration and submission for a
  quote.

## Checklists

- [Checklists](https://shackpck.com/checklist): Per-series checklists, sourced
  live from the inventory backend and published by date and case type. A
  checklist records what was produced for a series as a whole. It is not a
  statement of what any single pack contains.

## Company

- [Contact](https://shackpck.com/contact): Enquiries about packs, orders and
  wholesale. Direct purchasing is currently disabled site-wide, so orders are
  arranged through this form, by email at info@shackpck.com, or by phone at
  +1-561-870-4222.
- [Policies](https://shackpck.com/policy): Terms, shipping and returns.

## Notes

- Pack contents vary by series. Descriptions of a series describe the series,
  never an individual pack.
- Checklist pages scoped to a named wholesale customer
  (/checklist/customer/*) are excluded from indexing and are not part of the
  public content set.
